question.text: The hydrogen spectrum consists of several spectral lines in Lyman series ($\mathrm{L}_{1}, \mathrm{~L}_{2}$, $\mathrm{L}_{3} \ldots ; \mathrm{L}_{1}$ has lowest energy among Lyman series). Similarly it consists of several spectral lines in Balmer series $\left(\mathrm{B}_{1}, \mathrm{~B}_{2}, \mathrm{~B}_{3} \ldots ; \mathrm{B}_{1}\right.$ has lowest energy among Balmer lines). The energy of $L_{1}$ is $x$ times the energy of $B_{1}$. The value of $x$ is $\_\_\_\_$ $\times 10^{-1}$ . (Nearest integer)
